title: Alex Staples
subtitle: Software Developer
introduction: My name is Alex. I'd like to introduce myself and put my name in for your open role as a software engineer!
body1: I am a developer from central Massachusetts, with over 10 years of experience and a specialty in front end web development for about the last 7. My software engineering experience is broad, having worked with numerous consulting firms, the enterprise space, as well as multiple startups. Right now, my perferred stack includes web technologies such as React, TypeScript, and the NodeJS toolchain.
body2: When I came across Two Barrels, some of the description of your company culture immediately caught my eye. Some examples - giving people a chance to individually grow, committing to skill building, and solid work-life logistics. Your emphasis on projects being a team effort, aiming to provide consistent support, is also an attractive notion.
body3: In regards to both of us, the model where you support the growth of multiple businesses looks to be a good matchup with my experience in the UX consultancy space.
conclusion: Thank you for considering my application, and if you would enjoy working with a person like me, please give me a message to start an interview!
